title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting and Bookkeeping

* Maintain day-to-day accounting entries in Tally.
* Record and reconcile purchase, sales, receipt, payment, journal and contra entries.
* Maintain general ledgers, party ledgers and supporting accounting records.
* Ensure that all transactions are accurately recorded and supported by appropriate documentation.
* Assist in the preparation of trial balances and periodic financial statements.

2. Banking and Reconciliation

* Record bank transactions and perform regular bank reconciliations.
* Maintain records of bank statements, payment instructions, receipts and transfers.
* Monitor outstanding payments, receivables and other financial obligations.
* Assist in preparing bank-related documents and responding to routine banking requirements.

3. Loan and Financial Documentation

* Maintain accurate records of loans given and taken, including principal amounts, interest rates, repayment schedules and maturity dates.
* Track interest calculations, repayments, renewals and outstanding balances.
* Maintain supporting agreements, confirmations, board resolutions and other financial documents.
* Assist with the preparation of loan statements and interest workings.

4. Statutory Compliance and Audit Support

* Assist with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with the company’s Chartered Accountant for accounting finalisation, tax filings and audit requirements.
* Compile vouchers, ledgers, bank statements and supporting documents for audits and financial reviews.
* Ensure timely organisation and retrieval of financial records.

5. Documentation and Record Management

* Maintain systematic physical and digital filing of accounting documents.
* Scan, organise and store documents in the company’s designated digital folders.
* Ensure that accounting records are complete, up to date and easily accessible.
* Maintain confidentiality of all financial, banking and company-related information.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Accounting Executive
company: Aaryan Leisure and Holidays Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Accounting Executive** to manage day-to-day accounting activities and maintain accurate financial records. The ideal candidate should have basic to intermediate accounting knowledge and hands-on experience with Tally, GST, and bookkeeping.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain day-to-day accounting entries in Tally.
* Record purchase, sales, payment, receipt, and journal vouchers.
* Reconcile bank statements and ledger accounts.
* Prepare invoices, debit notes, and credit notes.
* Maintain proper accounting records and documentation.
* Assist in monthly and yearly account closing.
* Ensure accurate bookkeeping and financial reporting.
* Coordinate with the CA for audits and statutory compliance.
* Prepare GST-related data and assist in GST compliance.
* Handle vendor and customer account reconciliation.
* Perform other accounting and administrative tasks as assigned.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or equivalent.
* 1–3 years of experience in accounting.
* Good knowledge of accounting principles.
* Hands-on experience with **Tally ERP/Tally Prime**.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of **GST**.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel** and Microsoft Office.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in preparing and filing **GST Returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, etc.)** will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of **TDS**, bookkeeping, and basic taxation.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Experience

* **1+ year of experience in Accounting or Finance.**
* **or CA Articleship experience (only for CA Dropouts).**

Employment Type

* Full-time

Pay: ₹12,500.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Cashier cum Accountant
description:
**Industry:** Automobile  
**Location:** Ankurhati, Domjur, Howrah, West Bengal  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Cashier cum Accounts Executive to manage daily cash transactions, billing, payment collection, and basic accounting activities at our automobile dealership. The ideal candidate should have good numerical skills, accuracy in financial transactions, and knowledge of accounting procedures.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle daily cash receipts, payments, and customer transactions.
* Prepare and maintain cash books, vouchers, receipts, and payment records.
* Manage customer billing, invoice generation, and payment follow-ups.
* Maintain daily cash balances and perform cash reconciliation.
* Record financial transactions in accounting software or ERP systems.
* Handle bank deposits, cheque entries, and online payment records.
* Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and ledger maintenance.
* Coordinate with the sales, service, and accounts departments for transaction-related matters.
* Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions.
* Prepare daily cash reports and submit them to the reporting manager.
* Ensure accuracy in financial records and compliance with company procedures.

Eligibility Criteria

* **Qualification:** Graduate in Commerce (B.Com preferred).
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of relevant experience in cashiering or accounts.
* Experience in the automobile dealership industry will be an added advantage.
* Basic knowledge of accounting principles, MS Excel, and accounting software.
* Good numerical, communication, and organizational skills.
* Honest, responsible, and capable of handling cash securely.

Preferred Skills

* Cash handling and reconciliation
* Billing and invoice management
* Basic accounting and ledger entries
* MS Excel and accounting software
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Time management and coordination

Work Location

**Ankurhati, Domjur, Howrah**

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV with the HR Department.**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹13,000.00 per month

title: Accounts and Finance Executive
description:
**Job Description – Manager Accounts**

**The Manager – Accounts** is responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end accounting operations, financial reporting, statutory compliance, and investment / share market accounting at

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting \& Financial Management**

Oversee day\-to\-day accounting operations including books of accounts, ledgers, journals, and vouchers.

ü Ensure timely month\-end and year\-end closing of accounts.

ü Review accounting entries and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

**Statutory \& Taxation Compliance**

ü Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other statutory requirements.

**Share Market \& Investment Accounting**

ü Maintain accounting records for investments in shares, mutual funds, and other securities.

ü Track purchase, sale, valuation, and income from investments.

ü Account for capital gains, dividends, and corporate actions.

ü Support compliance and reporting related to share market transactions.

**MIS \& Financial Reporting**

ü Prepare and review financial statements and management MIS reports.

ü Analyze financial data and highlight key observations to management.

ü Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

**Team Management \& Coordination**

ü Supervise and guide Accounts Executives and support staff.

ü Allocate work, review output, and ensure timelines are met.

ü Coordinate with internal departments for financial data and documentation.

**Authority \& Accountability**

ü Authorized to approve routine accounting entries and financial documentation as delegated.

ü Accountable for accuracy of accounts, statutory compliance, and confidentiality of financial information.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

ü Strong knowledge of accounting principles and standards

ü Sound knowledge of share market / investment accounting

ü Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software (Tally / ERP)

ü Analytical, detail\-oriented, and team management skills

**Educational Qualification \& Experience**

ü CA (Inter) – mandatory

ü Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) – mandatory

ü 5–10 years of experience in Accounts \& Finance, including exposure to investment accounting

**Working Conditions**

ü Full\-time role based at the Corporate Office

ü Working hours as per company policy

Accounts Department Team shall strictly adhere to company policies, financial discipline, confidentiality norms, and professional ethics.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person
